reports.title: PROG Holdings Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results

guidance.heading: 2026 Outlook
section: Given the ongoing macroeconomic pressures on many of our consumers, the Company is reducing its revenues and earnings outlook ranges for the Fiscal Year ending December 31, 2026 as well as providing outlook for the fourth quarter of 2026. This outlook assumes an operating environment for the remainder of the year that is consistent with current conditions including the current financial pressures and uncertainties for our customers, no material changes in the Company's decisioning posture, no meaningful increase in unemployment rates for our consumer base, and an effective tax rate for non-GAAP EPS of approximately 26%. This outlook also assumes we enter into the ASR program during the fourth quarter of 2026 to repurchase $100.0 million of our common stock, with our non-GAAP EPS outlook reflecting only the initial delivery of approximately 80% of the shares to be repurchased, and excluding the remaining shares, if any, delivered at final settlement. However, there can be no assurance that we will enter into the ASR program as anticipated or at all.
